scope: Contemporary mineral context, separate from historical supplier cohorts and model inputs. Mining nodes describe source regions, never specific mines or verified Apple origins. All commodity-compatible supply and transport links are inferred; recycling, purchases, allocations and actual shipment paths remain unknown.

sourceChoice.basis: The 2026 Form SD explicitly does not file a CMR. The latest CMR (2024, filed 2025) contains a country-of-origin table and refers to a separate facility list. Facility names are therefore parsed from the current Apple-published 2026 materials annex, not invented or misattributed to the SEC exhibit. The older static Apple-Smelter-and-Refiner-List.pdf covers 2022 and is not used.
